   = displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate   = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex   = 10
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Text")
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextSpanish",  textSpanish)
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("TextEnglish",  textEnglish)

            StateLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(1, -90, 0, 16),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 36),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text     = GetText("Botón", "Button"),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 11,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ZIndex   = 10
            })
            StateLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "TextDim")
            RowKit.Chip(StateLabel, "Accent")
            StateLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 38)

            local DetachBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -70, 0.5, -14),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Text     = "↗",
                TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0),
                Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 13,
                ZIndex   = 15
            })
            corner(DetachBtn, 6)
            RowKit.Control(DetachBtn, true)

            local PinBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(0, 28, 0, 28),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0.5, -14),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Image    = "rbxassetid://83537941312438",
                ImageColor3 = Theme.Text,
                ScaleType   = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch,
                ZIndex   = 15
            })
            corner(PinBtn, 6)
            stroke(PinBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)
            RowKit.Control(PinBtn)

            local function syncExternalState()
                if not isMirror or not mirrorSource then return end
                local floating = false
                local locked = false
                pcall(function() floating = mirrorSource.GetFloating() end)
                pcall(function() locked = mirrorSource.GetLocked() end)
                DetachBtn.Text = floating and "←" or "↗"
                PinBtn.Image = locked and "rbxassetid://91959170037380" or "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
            end
            syncExternalState()

            if not isMirror then
                local favId = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish
                local isFavorite = SavedFavoriteIds[favId] or false
                local FavBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -104, 0.5, -15),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431",
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    ZIndex = 15
                })

                local favRow = nil
                local function syncFavoriteRow()
                    favoriteControlRefreshers = {}
                    if favRow then
                        pcall(function() favRow.Holder:Destroy() end)
                        favRow = nil
                    end
                    if isFavorite and AutoTabFavoritosRef then
                        favRow = AutoTabFavoritosRef:CreateFloatingButton(
                            textSpanish, textEnglish, cooldown, cb, true,
                            {
                                ToggleFloating = function() toggleFloating() end,
                                ToggleLock = function() toggleLock() end,
                                GetFloating = function() return isFloating end,
                                GetLocked = function() return isLocked end,
                            }
                        )
                        if favRow.SyncExternalState then
                            table.insert(favoriteControlRefreshers, favRow.SyncExternalState)
                        end
                    end
                end
                FavBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    isFavorite = not isFavorite
                    FavBtn.Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431"
                    SavedFavoriteIds[favId] = isFavorite or nil
                    syncFavoriteRow()
                    SyncFavoritesToConfig()
                end)

                syncFavoriteRow()
            end

            local HolderClick = mk("TextButton", {
                Parent   = Holder,
                Size     = UDim2.new(1, isMirror and -100 or -120, 1, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text     = "",
                ZIndex   = 13
            })

            HolderClick.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(Holder, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = RowKit.HOVER}):Play()
            end)
            HolderClick.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
                TweenService:Create(Holder, TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                    {BackgroundTransparency = RowKit.IDLE}):Play()
            end)

            HolderClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                if onCooldown then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                RowKit.Press(Holder)
                HolderStroke.Color = Theme.Accent
                HolderStroke.Transparency = 0.1
                TweenService:Create(HolderStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.45), {Color = Theme.Stroke, Transparency = 0.55}):Play()
                pcall(cb)
                startCooldown()
            end)

            local function createFloatingWindow()
                FloatingGlow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent   = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(216, 48),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -108, 0.5, -24),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex  = 3
                })
                corner(FloatingGlow, 999)

                local pillW = math.max(120, FloatingPillV5.FitWidth(displayText, 20))
                FloatingWindow = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent   = Window.ScreenGui,
                    Size     = UDim2.fromOffset(pillW, 34),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -pillW / 2, 0.5, -17),
                    BackgroundColor3 = FloatingPillV5.OffColor(),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.12,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex  = 4
                })
                FloatPos.Apply(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow)
                if FloatPos.IsLocked(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish) then
                    isLocked = true
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                end
                corner(FloatingWindow, 999)
                local pillStroke = stroke(FloatingWindow, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255), 2, 0.15)
                pillStroke:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", nil)
                mk("UIGradient", {
                    Rotation = 90,
                    Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                        NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.35),
                    }),
                }, FloatingWindow)
                local pillScale = mk("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, FloatingWindow)

                FloatLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                    Parent   = FloatingWindow,
                    Name     = "FloatLabel",
                    Size     = UDim2.new(1, -24, 1, 0),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text     = onCooldown and StateLabel.Text or displayText,
                    TextColor3 = onCooldown and Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170) or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
                    Font     = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                    TextSize = 20,
                    TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
                    TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
                    TextTruncate   = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                    ZIndex   = 5,
                })
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextSpanish",  textSpanish)
                FloatLabel:SetAttribute("TextEnglish",  textEnglish)

                local function flashBtn()
                    pillScale.Scale = 0.9
                    TweenService:Create(pillScale, TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Scale = 1}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.08),
                        {BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent, BackgroundTransparency = 0.05}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.08), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
                    task.delay(0.22, function()
                        if FloatingWindow and FloatingWindow.Parent then
                            TweenService:Create(FloatingWindow, TweenInfo.new(0.25),
                                {BackgroundColor3 = FloatingPillV5.OffColor(), BackgroundTransparency = 0.12}):Play()
                            TweenService:Create(pillStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0.15}):Play()
                        end
                    end)
                    if cooldown > 0 then
                        local fill = mk("Frame", {
                            Parent = FloatingWindow,
                            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                            BackgroundTransparency = 0.7,
                            BorderSizePixel = 0,
                            ZIndex = 4,
                        })
                        corner(fill, 999)
                        local tw = TweenService:Create(fill, TweenInfo.new(cooldown, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)})
                        tw.Completed:Connect(function() fill:Destroy() end)
                        tw:Play()
                    end
                end

                local dragging  = false
                local dragStart = nil
                local startPos  = nil

                local FloatClick = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent   = FloatingWindow,
                    Size     = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Text = "",
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    Active = true,
                    Selectable = false,
                    ZIndex   = 6
                })

                FloatClick.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    if dragging or onCooldown then return end
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    flashBtn()
                    pcall(cb)
                    startCooldown()
                end)

                local function syncGlow()
                    if FloatingGlow and FloatingGlow.Parent then
                        FloatingGlow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(
                            FloatingWindow.Size.X.Offset + 16,
                            FloatingWindow.Size.Y.Offset + 12)
                        FloatingGlow.Position = UDim2.new(
                            FloatingWindow.Position.X.Scale,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.X.Offset - 8,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Scale,
                            FloatingWindow.Position.Y.Offset - 6)
                    end
                end
                syncGlow()
                track(FloatingWindow:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(syncGlow))

                FloatClick.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or  input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch)
                    and not isLocked then
                        dragging  = false
                        dragStart = input.Position
                        startPos  = FloatingWindow.Position
                    end
                end)

                track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                    if dragStart and not isLocked
                    and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                    or   input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                        if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
                            dragging = true
                            FloatingWindow.Position = UDim2.new(
                                startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                                startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
                        end
                    end
                end))

                track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        task.defer(function() dragging = false end)
                        dragStart = nil
                    end
                end))

                table.insert(Window.FloatingToggles, {Window = FloatingWindow, Name = displayText})
            end

            toggleFloating = function()
                if isMirror and mirrorSource then
                    pcall(mirrorSource.ToggleFloating)
                    syncExternalState()
                    return
                end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.6)
                if not isFloating then
                    isFloating = true
                    createFloatingWindow()
                    DetachBtn.Text = "←"
                else
                    isFloating   = false
                    FloatLabel   = nil
                    if FloatingWindow then FloatingWindow:Destroy(); FloatingWindow = nil end
                    if FloatingGlow   then FloatingGlow:Destroy();   FloatingGlow   = nil end
                    DetachBtn.Text = "↗"
                    isLocked   = false
                    PinBtn.Image = "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                end
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end

            toggleLock = function()
                if isMirror and mirrorSource then
                    pcall(mirrorSource.ToggleLock)
                    syncExternalState()
                    return
                end
                if not isFloating then return end
                playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                isLocked = not isLocked
                if isLocked then FloatPos.Save(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, FloatingWindow, Window.ScreenGui) else FloatPos.SetLocked(nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish, false) end
                PinBtn.Image = isLocked
                    and "rbxassetid://91959170037380"
                    or  "rbxassetid://83537941312438"
                for _, refresh in ipairs(favoriteControlRefreshers) do pcall(refresh) end
            end

            DetachBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFloating)
            PinBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleLock)

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            if not isMirror then
                Window._RegisterGlobalOption(self, {
                    Id = nameSpanish .. "::" .. textSpanish,
                    NameSpanish = textSpanish,
                    NameEnglish = textEnglish,
                    Holder = Holder,
                    Kind = "Button",
                })
            end

            return {
                Holder = Holder,
                Fire = function()
                    if not onCooldown then
                        pcall(cb)
                        startCooldown()
                    end
                end,
                SetCooldown = function(secs)
                    cooldown = secs or cooldown
                end,
                SyncExternalState = syncExternalState,
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateSlider(text, min, max, default, callback, isMirror)
            local value = default or min
            local pendingValue = value
            local isDragging = false
            local lastUpdateTime = 0
            local UPDATE_THROTTLE = 0.008

            local Carousel = nil
            local children = TabPage:GetChildren()
            for i = #children, 1, -1 do
                local child = children[i]
                if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
                    if child:GetAttribute("IsSliderCarouselSection") and Tab._LastSliderCarousel
                    and Tab._LastSliderCarousel.Section == child then
                        Carousel = Tab._LastSliderCarousel
                    end
                    break
                end
            end

            if not Carousel then
                local SliderSection = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = TabPage,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 134),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 9
                })
                SliderSection:SetAttribute("IsSliderCarouselSection", true)

                local Viewport = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = SliderSection,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 110),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 0),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ClipsDescendants = true,
                    ZIndex = 10
                })

                local PrevBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Viewport,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0.5, -19),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "‹",
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextSize = 30,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                corner(PrevBtn, 19)
                stroke(PrevBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)

                local NextBtn = mk("TextButton", {
                    Parent = Viewport,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 38, 0, 38),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -42, 0.5, -19),
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Background,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "›",
                    TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                    TextSize = 30,
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                corner(NextBtn, 19)
                stroke(NextBtn, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.5)

                local DotHolder = mk("Frame", {
                    Parent = SliderSection,
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 0, 16),
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 114),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    ZIndex = 60
                })
                mk("UIListLayout", {
                    Parent = DotHolder,
                    FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal,
                    HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center,
                    VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Center,
                    Padding = UDim.new(0, 6),
                    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
                })

                Carousel = {
                    Section = SliderSection,
                    Viewport = Viewport,
                    PrevBtn = PrevBtn,
                    NextBtn = NextBtn,
                    DotHolder = DotHolder,
                    Cards = {},
                    Dots = {},
                    ActiveIndex = 1,
                    Reflow = nil,
                    GoTo = nil,
                }
                Tab._LastSliderCarousel = Carousel

                local function refreshDots()
                    local count = #Carousel.Cards
                    for i, dot in ipairs(Carousel.Dots) do
                        dot.BackgroundColor3 = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex) and Theme.Text or Theme.AccentOff
                        dot.BackgroundTransparency = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex) and 0 or 0.35
                        dot.Size = (i == Carousel.ActiveIndex)
                            and UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 7)
                            or UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7)
                    end
                    Carousel.PrevBtn.Visible = count > 1
                    Carousel.NextBtn.Visible = count > 1
                    Carousel.DotHolder.Visible = count > 1
                end

                local function reflow()
                    local count = #Carousel.Cards
                    if count == 0 then
                        refreshDots()
                        return
                    end

                    local viewportWidth = Carousel.Viewport.AbsoluteSize.X
                    local cardWidth = math.clamp(viewportWidth * 0.52, 240, 320)
                    local cardHeight = 96
                    local step = cardWidth * 0.78
                    local centerX = viewportWidth * 0.5 - cardWidth * 0.5

                    for i, cardData in ipairs(Carousel.Cards) do
                        local card = cardData.Holder
                        if card and card.Parent then
                            local offset = (i - Carousel.ActiveIndex) * step
                            local distance = math.abs(i - Carousel.ActiveIndex)
                            local targetX = centerX + offset
                            local targetWidth = distance == 0 and cardWidth or cardWidth * 0.86
                            local targetHeight = distance == 0 and cardHeight or cardHeight * 0.90
                            local targetY = 4 + (cardHeight - targetHeight) * 0.5
                            local isActive = distance == 0

                            TweenService:Create(
                                card,
                                TweenInfo.new(0.15, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                                {
                                    Position = UDim2.new(0, targetX, 0, targetY),
                                    Size = UDim2.new(0, targetWidth, 0, targetHeight),
                                    BackgroundTransparency = isActive and 0.12 or 0.72
                                }
                            ):Play()
                            card.ZIndex = isActive and 50 or 20 - math.min(distance, 4)
                            for _, descendant in ipairs(card:GetDescendants()) do
                                if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
                                    descendant.ZIndex = isActive and 51 or 21 - math.min(distance, 4)
                                end
                                if descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
                                    descendant.TextTransparency = isActive and 0 or 0.35
                                elseif descendant:IsA("ImageLabel") or descendant:IsA("ImageButton") then
                                    descendant.ImageTransparency = isActive and 0 or 0.35
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    refreshDots()
                end
                Carousel.Reflow = reflow

                local function goTo(index)
                    local count = #Carousel.Cards
                    if count == 0 then return end
                    Carousel.ActiveIndex = math.clamp(index, 1, count)
                    reflow()
                end
                Carousel.GoTo = goTo

                PrevBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    goTo(Carousel.ActiveIndex - 1)
                end)
                NextBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    goTo(Carousel.ActiveIndex + 1)
                end)

                local swipeStartX = nil
                Viewport.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
                    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                        swipeStartX = input.Position.X
                    end
                end)
                Viewport.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
                    if swipeStartX and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                    or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                        local deltaX = input.Position.X - swipeStartX
                        swipeStartX = nil
                        if math.abs(deltaX) >= 45 then
                            if deltaX < 0 then
                                goTo(Carousel.ActiveIndex + 1)
                            else
                                goTo(Carousel.ActiveIndex - 1)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end)

                Carousel._resizeConnection = Viewport:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(reflow)
            end

            local Holder = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Carousel.Viewport,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 96),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 10),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.72,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                Active = true,
                ZIndex = 53
            })
            Holder:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            Holder:SetAttribute("IsSliderHolder", true)
            corner(Holder, 14)
            stroke(Holder, Theme.Stroke, 1.5, 0.45)
            buildAnimatedBorder(Holder, Theme.Border, UDim.new(0, 14), true)
            Holder.Visible = not SlidersHidden

            table.insert(Carousel.Cards, {Holder = Holder})

            local dot = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Carousel.DotHolder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 7, 0, 7),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.35,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                LayoutOrder = #Carousel.Dots + 1,
                ZIndex = 31
            })
            corner(dot, 4)
            table.insert(Carousel.Dots, dot)

            Holder.Destroying:Connect(function()
                for i, cardData in ipairs(Carousel.Cards) do
                    if cardData.Holder == Holder then
                        table.remove(Carousel.Cards, i)
                        break
                    end
                end
                if Carousel.ActiveIndex > #Carousel.Cards then
                    Carousel.ActiveIndex = math.max(1, #Carousel.Cards)
                end
                for i, existingDot in ipairs(Carousel.Dots) do
                    if existingDot == dot then
                        table.remove(Carousel.Dots, i)
                        pcall(function() existingDot:Destroy() end)
                        break
                    end
                end
                if Carousel.Reflow then Carousel.Reflow() end
            end)

            Carousel.Reflow()

            local LabelTxt = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -154, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = text,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 16
            })
            LabelTxt:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Text")

            local ValueLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 58, 0, 22),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -146, 0, 12),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = tostring(math.floor(value * 100) / 100),
                TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 15,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                ZIndex = 51
            })
            ValueLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Accent")

            local MinLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 15),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 1, -22),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = tostring(min),
                TextColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                ZIndex = 16
            })
            MinLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")

            local MaxLabel = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 55, 0, 15),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -73, 1, -22),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = tostring(max),
                TextColor3 = Theme.AccentOff,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
                TextSize = 10,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
                ZIndex = 16
            })
            MaxLabel:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "AccentOff")

            local SliderBackground = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, -36, 0, 6),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 62),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderTrack,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.18,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Active = true,
                ZIndex = 51
            })
            SliderBackground:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderTrack")
            corner(SliderBackground, 3)

            local SliderFill = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = SliderBackground,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderFill,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 52
            })
            SliderFill:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderFill")
            corner(SliderFill, 3)

            local SliderThumb = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = Holder,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 26),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 57),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderThumb,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                Active = true,
                ZIndex = 53
            })
            SliderThumb:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderThumb")
            corner(SliderThumb, 9)
            stroke(SliderThumb, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.55)

            local ThumbGlow = mk("Frame", {
                Parent = SliderThumb,
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 8, 1, 8),
                Position = UDim2.new(0, -4, 0, -4),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.SliderThumb,
                BackgroundTransparency = 0.76,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ZIndex = 52
            })
            ThumbGlow:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "SliderThumb")
            corner(ThumbGlow, 12)

            local function UpdateSlider(percentage, commit, animate)
                percentage = math.clamp(percentage, 0, 1)
                pendingValue = min + (max - min) * percentage
                if commit then
                    value = pendingValue
                end

                local barWidth = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X
                local targetSize = UDim2.new(percentage, 0, 1, 0)
                local thumbTarget = UDim2.new(0, 18 + barWidth * percentage - 9, 0, 57)

                if animate then
                    TweenService:Create(SliderFill, TweenInfo.new(0.05), {Size = targetSize}):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(
                        SliderThumb,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.04, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {Position = thumbTarget}
                    ):Play()
                    TweenService:Create(
                        ThumbGlow,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = 0.4}
                    ):Play()
                else
                    SliderFill.Size = targetSize
                    SliderThumb.Position = thumbTarget
                    ThumbGlow.BackgroundTransparency = 0.4
                end

                ValueLabel.Text = tostring(math.floor(pendingValue * 100) / 100)

                if commit then
                    task.spawn(function()
                        pcall(callback, value)
                    end)
                end
            end

            local function isThisCardActive()
                for i, cardData in ipairs(Carousel.Cards) do
                    if cardData.Holder == Holder then
                        return i == Carousel.ActiveIndex
                    end
                end
                return false
            end

            local function OnSliderClick(input)
                if not isThisCardActive() then return end
                if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
                    isDragging = true
                    TweenService:Create(
                        SliderThumb,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {Size = UDim2.new(0, 21, 0, 30)}
                    ):Play()
                end
            end

            local function OnSliderRelease(input)
                if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                    local percentage = math.clamp((pendingValue - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
                    isDragging = false
                    UpdateSlider(percentage, true, true)
                    TweenService:Create(
                        SliderThumb,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 26)}
                    ):Play()

                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)

                    TweenService:Create(
                        ThumbGlow,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.3, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut),
                        {BackgroundTransparency = 0.76}
                    ):Play()
                end
            end

            SliderBackground.InputBegan:Connect(OnSliderClick)
            SliderThumb.InputBegan:Connect(OnSliderClick)

            track(UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
                if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
                    local currentTime = tick()
                    if currentTime - lastUpdateTime >= UPDATE_THROTTLE then
                        lastUpdateTime = currentTime

                        local relativeX = input.Position.X - SliderBackground.AbsolutePosition.X
                        local barWidth = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X
                        local percentage = math.clamp(relativeX / barWidth, 0, 1)

                        UpdateSlider(percentage, false, false)
                    end
                end
            end))

            track(UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(OnSliderRelease))

            track(SliderBackground:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(function()
                local currentPercentage = math.clamp((value - min) / (max - min), 0, 1)
                local barWidth = SliderBackground.AbsoluteSize.X
                local thumbTargetX = 18 + barWidth * currentPercentage - 9
                SliderThumb.Position = UDim2.new(0, thumbTargetX, 0, 57)
            end))

            local initialPercentage = (value - min) / (max - min)
            task.defer(function()
                if Holder.Parent then
                    UpdateSlider(initialPercentage)
                end
            end)

            local resetRotation = 0
            local ResetBtn = nil
            local function doReset()
                value = default or min
                UpdateSlider((value - min) / (max - min))
                if ResetBtn then
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    resetRotation = resetRotation + 360
                    TweenService:Create(
                        ResetBtn,
                        TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out),
                        {Rotation = resetRotation}
                    ):Play()
                end
            end

            if not isMirror then
                ResetBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 18, 0, 18),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -82, 0, 12),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = "rbxassetid://98954218682855",
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    ZIndex = 20
                })
                ResetBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(doReset)

                local favId = nameSpanish .. "::" .. text
                local isFavorite = SavedFavoriteIds[favId] or false
                local FavBtn = mk("ImageButton", {
                    Parent = Holder,
                    Size = UDim2.new(0, 22, 0, 22),
                    Position = UDim2.new(1, -52, 0, 10),
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431",
                    ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Fit,
                    ZIndex = 20
                })

                local favRow = nil
                local function syncFavoriteRow()
                    if favRow then
                        pcall(function() favRow.Holder:Destroy() end)
                        favRow = nil
                    end
                    if isFavorite and AutoTabFavoritosRef then
                        favRow = AutoTabFavoritosRef:CreateSlider(text, min, max, value, function(newVal)
                            value = newVal
                            UpdateSlider((value - min) / (max - min))
                            pcall(callback, newVal)
                        end, true)
                    end
                end
                syncFavoriteRow()

                FavBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
                    playSound(Sounds.Click, 0.5)
                    isFavorite = not isFavorite
                    FavBtn.Image = isFavorite and "rbxassetid://113655648685815" or "rbxassetid://90877976276431"
                    SavedFavoriteIds[favId] = isFavorite or nil
                    syncFavoriteRow()
                    SyncFavoritesToConfig()
                end)
            end

            Carousel.Reflow()

            if not isMirror then
                Window._RegisterGlobalOption(self, {
                    Id = nameSpanish .. "::" .. text,
                    NameSpanish = text,
                    NameEnglish = text,
                    Holder = Holder,
                    Kind = "Slider",
                    GetValue = function() return value end,
                    SetValue = function(v)
                        local pct = math.clamp((v - min) / math.max(max - min, 0.0001), 0, 1)
                        UpdateSlider(pct, true, false)
                    end,
                    Min = min,
                    Max = max,
                })
            end

            resetScrollTop(TabPage)

            return {
                Holder = Holder,
                Set = function(newValue)
                    value = math.clamp(newValue, min, max)
                    UpdateSlider((value - min) / (max - min))
                end,
                Get = function()
                    return value
                end,
                Reset = function()
                    doReset()
                end,
                SetMin = function(newMin)
                    min = newMin
                    MinLabel.Text = tostring(min)
                end,
                SetMax = function(newMax)
                    max = newMax
                    MaxLabel.Text = tostring(max)
                end,
                _labelES = text,
                _labelEN = text,
                _min = min,
                _max = max,
                _value = value,
                _callback = callback,
            }
        end

        function Tab:CreateButton(textSpanish, textEnglishOrCallback, callbackOrIcon, iconAsset)
            local contentParent = self._ContentParent or TabPage
            local textEnglish = textSpanish
            local callback, icon

            if type(textEnglishOrCallback) == "string" then
                textEnglish = textEnglishOrCallback
                callback = callbackOrIcon
                icon = iconAsset
            else
                callback = textEnglishOrCallback
                icon = callbackOrIcon
            end

            local displayText = GetText(textSpanish, textEnglish)
            local iconAsset = icon

            local BtnWrapper = mk("Frame", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                BorderSizePixel = 0,
                ClipsDescendants = true,
                ZIndex = 9
            }, contentParent)
            corner(BtnWrapper, 12)

            local Btn = mk("TextButton", {
                Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Secondary,
                Text = iconAsset and "" or displayText,
                TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
                TextSize = 14,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 9
            }, BtnWrapper)
            Btn:SetAttribute("ThemeRole", "Secondary")
            corner(Btn, 12)
            stroke(BtnWrapper, Theme.Stroke, 1, 0.6)
            mk("UIGradient", {
                Rotation = 90,
                Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0),
                    NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.2),
                }),
            }, Btn)
            local BtnChevron = mk("TextLabel", {
                Parent = Btn,
                Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 1, 0),
                AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0),
                Position = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 0),
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Text = "›",
                TextColor3 = Theme.Accent,
                Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack,
                TextSize = 22,
                ZIndex = 10,
            })
            BtnChevron:SetAttribute("ThemeTextRole", "Accent")
            BtnChevron:SetAttribute("IgnoreTextEffect", true)
            if contentParent == TabPage then resetScrollTop(TabPage) end

            if iconAsset then
                mk("ImageLa
